MATCH (impl:Type)-[:IMPLEMENTS]->(iface:Type)
WHERE iface.fqn IN [
  'org.thingsboard.server.dao.user.UserService',
  'org.thingsboard.server.service.security.system.SystemSecurityService',
  'org.thingsboard.server.cache.limits.RateLimitService',
  'org.thingsboard.rule.engine.api.MailService',
  'org.thingsboard.server.service.security.auth.mfa.TwoFactorAuthService',
  'org.thingsboard.server.dao.settings.SecuritySettingsService'
]
MATCH (a:Artifact)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Package)-[:CONTAINS]->(impl)
RETURN iface.fqn AS interface,
       impl.fqn AS implementation,
       split(a.fileName, '/target/')[0] + '/src/main/java/' + replace(impl.fqn, '.', '/') + '.java' AS file
ORDER BY interface, implementation
